那一天，全世界都在讨论同一个问题——在机器面前，人类的智力还有尊严吗？

Rescue teams are working to pull survivors from the rubble, while an aftershock has hit the area, raising fears of further casualties.

title: Zambia resumes vote count after pause over violence
description: Zambia resumed vote counting Friday after a nationwide suspension over alleged attacks on polling staff and stolen marked ballot papers.
